data.one_liner: Compose multiple animations sequentially using a single controller.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to define a sequence of animatables with specific durations and tags using a builder. It automatically computes the total animation duration and merges multiple animatables into a single animation per tag without manual interval calculation.
use_when: You need to orchestrate complex staggered animations with a single AnimationController
You want to avoid manually calculating percentage intervals for sequential animations
avoid_when: You need physics-based motion or complex timeline state machines provided by Rive
You prefer implicit animations or simple one-off tweens
strengths: Removes the need to calculate manual percentage intervals
Uses only a single AnimationController for complex sequences
Easy to chain multiple animatables under the same tag
weaknesses: Animations with the same tag cannot overlap and must be ordered
Limited documentation beyond the basic README example
